description: This file defines a LightningJS component named 'Loader', which displays a loading animation consisting of three animated circles that fade in and out repeatedly.

classes.name: Loader
classes.description: A LightningJS component that shows an animated loading indicator with three fading circles.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates the interval-based animation that toggles the alpha value of the circles to create a fade-in and fade-out effect.
